text: Okay, let's get started with the weekly planning sync for the bakery inventory app.
Last week we shipped the barcode scanner fix, and crash reports dropped by about half.
The main open question is whether we move the nightly sync to every two hours.
I think two hours is fine as long as the server load stays under the current limit.
We agreed to keep the old export format until the end of the quarter.
Priya will draft the migration guide for the new export format by Friday.
The pastry team asked for a low stock alert on flour and butter.
Marcus will prototype the low stock alert and share screenshots next week.
Design wants the alert to be a banner, not a popup, so it does not block scanning.
Testing on the older tablets is still slow, roughly ten seconds per sync.
We decided to drop support for the oldest tablet model in the next release.
That's everything for today, thanks everyone, see you next Tuesday.
